projects.title: Feature-scoped mechanical part
projects.prompt: Create one printable asymmetric mounting bracket as a single required output. Make the body 110 mm wide, 72 mm deep, and 6 mm thick. Add one 5 mm diameter through-bore named pivot_bore, one recessed 30 mm by 12 mm pocket named cable_pocket, and place the bore 18 mm from the left edge and 14 mm from the front edge rather than at the center. Do not create a mating part or any additional output.

projects.title: Cross-feature layout part
projects.prompt: Create one printable sensor plate as a single required output, 120 mm wide, 80 mm deep, and 5 mm thick. Add two named feature types: four mounting holes and one irregular cable recess. The holes and recess must have an explicit asymmetric relationship: arrange the hole group toward the upper-left and the recess toward the lower-right, with named participants mounting_hole_group and cable_recess_layout. Preserve both participants in the layout constraint and create exactly one output. Do not create a mating part.

projects.title: Two-output mating assembly
projects.prompt: Create a two-output mating enclosure: required base_shell output and required sliding_lid output. Base is 100 mm wide, 70 mm deep, 4 mm thick; lid mates over the base with 0.3 mm clearance and 2 mm overlap at the rim, aligned on the same center plane. Add a mounting_boss feature unique to base_shell and a latch_rail feature unique to sliding_lid. Preserve the overlap/clearance relationship and generate exactly two required printable outputs, with no third output.

projects.title: Required plus optional output
projects.prompt: Create a two-output desktop organizer with one required printable tray output and one optional printable label_plate output. The required tray must be independently useful, 140 mm wide, 90 mm deep, and 30 mm tall, with an off-center pen pocket. The optional label plate may be omitted without invalidating the tray; if generated, keep it a separate optional output. Do not make the required tray depend on the optional output.
